title: Small business administration — UI directions
brief: Choose the visual direction for the admin (stock and supplies, single-tenant, small business) before implementing with Terminal + shadcn-svelte. It must work on a PC at the shop and another on the same network; eventually a sale screen with a barcode scanner.

artboards.title: Dense with dark sidebar
artboards.tradeoff: Maximum data density and always-visible navigation; the dark sidebar clashes with the system's light theme and requires maintaining two palettes.

artboards.title: Airy with cards and hover actions
artboards.tradeoff: More readable and pleasant for administrative work; fewer rows per screen and actions hidden until hover make touch use difficult.

artboards.title: Point of sale: icon rail, grid and fixed cart
artboards.tradeoff: Optimized for fast sales with keyboard and scanner; an expandable rail is the app's single sidebar (icons + names) and now follows the light/dark theme like the rest. The grid + fixed cart structure does not suit administration screens.
